items.t: Said the recommendations across House Bills 1425, 1417 and 1549 support local law enforcement and prosecutors in using deflection and diversion practices.
items.q: The recommendations across these three bills support local law enforcement and prosecutors in using deflection and diversion practices – effectively interrupting misconduct early and intervening with treatment resources in cases where addiction and mental illness are the root cause,

items.t: Said provisions in the three bills will reduce barriers to reentry for people on community supervision and support cross-agency collaboration on medical coverage and state identification.
items.q: Provisions in these bills will also reduce barriers to reentry faced by people on community supervision; promote culturally responsive programming for people moving through the justice system; and support cross-agency collaboration to help justice-involved people secure medical coverage and state identification.

record.t: Was sworn in as the 40th lieutenant governor of North Dakota.
record.q: Michelle Strinden was sworn in as the 40th lieutenant governor of North Dakota on December 15, 2024.

record.t: Testified before the House Judiciary Committee in support of House Bills 1425, 1417 and 1549.
